import os
import warnings
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler, LabelEncoder
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
import xgboost as xgb

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
os.makedirs("submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load datasets
train_df = pd.read_csv("input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("input/sample_submission.csv")

# Extract features and targets
feature_cols = [c for c in train_df.columns if c not in ["id", "species"]]
X_train = train_df[feature_cols].to_numpy(dtype=np.float32)
y_train_str = train_df["species"].to_numpy()
X_test = test_df[feature_cols].to_numpy(dtype=np.float32)

# Encode labels
le = LabelEncoder()
y_train_enc = le.fit_transform(y_train_str)
target_names = le.classes_

# Stratified train/validation split
X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train_enc, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train_enc
)

# Feature scaling
scaler = StandardScaler()
X_tr_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(X_tr)
X_val_scaled = scaler.transform(X_val)
X_test_scaled = scaler.transform(X_test)

# Initialize and train Gradient Boosting model
model = xgb.XGBClassifier(
    n_estimators=400,
    learning_rate=0.05,
    max_depth=5,
    subsample=0.8,
    colsample_bytree=0.8,
    objective="multiclass",
    eval_metric="mlogloss",
    random_state=42,
    verbosity=0,
    enable_categorical=False,
)
model.fit(X_tr_scaled, y_tr)

# Validation prediction and scoring
val_probs = model.predict_proba(X_val_scaled)
val_probs = np.clip(val_probs, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)
val_probs = val_probs / val_probs.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
val_loss = log_loss(y_val, val_probs)
print(f"Validation Multi-class Log-Loss: {val_loss:.5f}")

# Retrain on full training data
model.fit(scaler.fit_transform(X_train), y_train_enc)

# Test prediction
test_probs = model.predict_proba(X_test_scaled)
test_probs = np.clip(test_probs, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)
test_probs = test_probs / test_probs.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)

# Format and save submission
submit_df = pd.DataFrame(test_probs, columns=target_names)
submit_df.insert(0, "id", test_df["id"])
submit_df = submit_df[sample_sub.columns]  # Ensure exact column order
submit_df.to_csv("submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved successfully to submission/submission.csv")
